description: This file defines the 'PolicyNotAccessibleException' class, a custom runtime exception in Java indicating that a policy was not found or the requester has insufficient permissions. It encompasses methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and a builder for constructing exceptions with detailed context.

classes.name: PolicyNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a policy is missing or access is denied, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing PolicyException.

classes.name: PolicyNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of PolicyNotAccessibleException with customizable properties.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a PolicyNotAccessibleException from a simple message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyNotAccessibleException by parsing a JSON object and attaching headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
